descriptions.tsonnet_b36_entry_copy_801af73c: Copies a 16-byte record from a table of 24-byte entries (table pointer at +20) into the first output, stores the entry's object pointer through the second output after calling its virtual slot 3, and, when a string output is given, retains the entry's shared string (+20 in the entry) and releases the string previously held there. Always returns 0. Field meanings are inferred. A negative or out-of-range index and a null object have not been behaviorally tested.
